rootCause.cause: Concurrent duplicate full-history Prisma reads materialize many multi-megabyte native query-result Strings at once. At the measured large-series boundary, napi_create_string_utf8 cannot create the JavaScript strings and Prisma returns GenericFailure. The individual values are valid; concurrent large-result multiplicity is the unsafe condition.

c01Relationship.reason: C01 shares only the preceding application-record Promise. Each P09 caller independently constructs a primitive seriesId and invokes SG Runtime; no C01 object enters Prisma.

repair.exactChange: Process-local, exact-series, in-flight-only coalescing of MarketDataRepository.readStoredSeries
rollback: Remove only the Phase 2.3R market-data coalescing tests; C01 rollback remains separate.

p10.successComputedLabelSemantics: Historical harness success label only; direct telemetry proves zero Forecast compute.
